about: John W. O'Dorisio, Jr. is an attorney providing legal services covering Real Estate: Business and Business / Corporate.

John O'Dorisio, Jr., who practices law in Denver, Colorado, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at University of Denver Sturm College of Law. He graduated in 1976. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1976.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
